title: Character Sheet Editor can undress an adult sheet
description: Clothes with words asking for nudity or undressing ('Remove all the clothes, leaving you nude and barefoot') came back dressed on Klein, whose prompt read 'Dress the character in Remove all the clothes'. Such words now route to Qwen-Image 2.1 with an undress prompt (bench: 4/4 on Fabio's adult sheet flowCSE_044, every figure, own face and hair). Child-safety unchanged: the typed words refuse at Age 0-17 and get the sheet looked at.
